item.title: Trump administration attempting to prosecute former FBI Director James Comey again
item.description: The Trump administration is attempting to prosecute James Comey for what it calls a decade-old leak of classified information. Comey's lawyers immediately dismissed the effort as invalid and outside the time limit.

item.title: Judge says DOJ illegally fired the daughter of former FBI director Comey
item.description: Maurene Comey served as a federal prosecutor in Manhattan for around a decade. A judicial ruling finding her dismissal unlawful adds to concerns of politically motivated firings at the DOJ.
item.content:encoded:
Maurene Comey served as a federal prosecutor in Manhattan for around a decade. A judicial ruling finding her dismissal unlawful adds to concerns of politically motivated firings at the DOJ.

item.title: Redistricting isn't playing out how the GOP hoped. And, Brazil's Lula wins 4th term
item.description: Republicans are spending millions on the midterms, and they still may not win districts drawn to favor them. And, Brazil's Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva won a fourth term in a stunning political comeback.

item.title: Trump escalates anti-Muslim attacks against El-Sayed in Michigan
item.description: President Trump intensified his anti-Muslim rhetoric against Michigan Senate candidate Abdul El-Sayed on Sunday, portraying him as a threat to national security and questioning his loyalty to the United States.

item.title: Republicans are spending millions and still may not win districts drawn to favor them
item.description: Republicans redrew congressional district lines to try to tilt the midterms in their favor. But now they are facing expensive and competitive races they had hoped to outmaneuver.

item.title: Politics chat: The polls show a Democratic sweep in the midterms. Can you trust them?
item.description: If you look at the few truly competitive seats, polls show a more complicated picture of momentum toward the Democratic Party in midterm House races. For the Senate, Republicans are on defense.

item.title: Democrats see an opportunity to tilt Pennsylvania's state legislature their way
item.description: Statehouse elections this fall could swing the balance of power in state capitals. In Pennsylvania, Democrats could take control of what has been a divided legislature.

item.title: Independent candidates sense a moment. Some Democrats hope they're right
item.description: As they look to win the Senate, Democrats are hoping that independent candidates in Nebraska and Montana can help them topple Republicans in a part of the country where their own brand is hurting.
